svg.text: Normal daytime service pattern: average trains per hour (tph) each way, Tuesday–Thursday 09:00–16:00, September 2026
Source: National Rail Darwin Push Port, services that ran. Routes are drawn to their termini; stations no route here stops at are left out.
Number beside a station: tph calling. White dot: the route stops. Capsule: major interchange between routes going different ways.
London Paddington – Bristol Temple Meads GW
